_about: Public-domain Jonathan Mayhew Wainwright, Episcopal provisional Bishop of New York, for the Word Hoard: his sermons for the African Mission School Society, the Domestic and Foreign Missionary Society and the Boston Female Society for Destitute Orphans, Inequality of Individual Wealth, Collegiate Education, Short Family Prayers, The Pathways and Abiding Places of Our Lord, The Land of Bondage, and his Thirty-Four Sermons. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 134 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

wainwright-african-mission: A discourse, on the occasion of forming the African Mission School Society : delivered in Christ Church, in Hartford, Connecticut, on Sunday evening, Aug. 10, 1828 (catalogued 1828)
wainwright-missionary-society: Sermon, preached before the Board of Directors of the Domestic and Foreign Missionary Society of the Protestant Episcopal Church in the United States of America, in St. James' Church, Philadelphia, on Tuesday, May 13, 1828 / published at the request of the Board (New-York: Printed by J. Seymour .., 1828)
wainwright-orphans: A Sermon Preached on the Anniversary of the Boston Female Society for Destitute Orphans (Dutton and Wentworth, 1835)
wainwright-inequality-wealth: Inequality of Individual Wealth the Ordinance of Providence, and Essential to Civilization: A (Dutton and Wentworth , printers to the State, 1835)
wainwright-collegiate-education: Collegiate education (Hartford, Press of Case, Tiffany & Burnham, 1847)
wainwright-family-prayers: Short family prayers for every morning & evening of the week, & for particular occasions (New York, E.P. Dutton & co., 1850)
wainwright-pathways: The pathways and abiding places of Our Lord : illustrated in the journal of a tour through the land of promise (New-York : D. Appleton & Company ; Philadelphia : Geo. S. Appleton, 1851)
wainwright-land-of-bondage: The land of bondage; its ancient monuments and present condition: being the journal of a tour in Egypt (New York : D. Appleton, 1852)
wainwright-thirty-four-sermons: Thirty four sermons (New York : D. Appleton and Co., 1856)
